prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1306; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this firm now represents the interests of our client in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while they were changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request written confirmation of the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data, repair estimates, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained pending resolution of this claim.
